messages.subject: rmr 1.3.1 available
parts:
Hi, 
I've just completed the release of rmr 1.3.1 which adds compatibility with major hadoop distros and completes the transition to Rmd documentation. If you peruse wiki and Rmd docs and find any broken links please let me know. Enjoy


Antonio

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: rmr 1.3.1 available
parts:
Hi Curtis,
you are right that we removed 1.3.1 and 2.0.0 is not yet tested on CDH3. Nonetheless it passed on CDH4 and I am confident the same is going to happen with CDH3. Give me one more day and I will be able to confirm it. If you really have to stick with the old version, I've just added some instructions on how to create the old builds. By the way, if you re-create 1.3.1 it will show a version number of 1.3 because of operator error (I added the tag before bumping the version). Other than that it is a 1.3.1 byte by byte.


Antonio

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: rmr 1.3.1 available
parts:
Sure you just code to the code tab select tags and select the download you want or click here. To install 
R CMD INSTALL path-to-unpacked-package/pkg

But let me discuss for a moment the trade offs of learning an obsolete version of a software because a great tutorial is available. rmr 2 and above is pretty different from 1.3. If you are starting now, is it worth your time learning 1.3 and then making the transition? Or you are going to stay with 1.3 forever? All the documentation on the wiki has been upgraded to 2.0 (or it should, please point me to any straddlers), including my own humble tutorial. I am more than willing to concede that it's not as good as Jeffrey's, but it's always up to date.


A
